name: you-plus
description: Skills that turn an expert's tacit moves — putting ideas into words, naming the pattern, checking against standards, filling what is missing — into a dialogue anyone can walk. The one being extended is you, not the AI.

plugins.name: shape-your-feature
plugins.description: Use before you start building, when you already know what you want to build. Give it the thing you want to build, in your own words — it draws out what you already have and know, hands you how to search for what is missing, and lands everything in a plan you can hand to an implementing AI.
